platform: Workday Student is a cloud SaaS, browser-based higher-education SIS with responsive web access and a shared Workday iOS/Android app.

distinctive_features.why_it_matters: A shared identity links academic records with campus employment, work hours, funding, and pay.

distinctive_features.feature: Financial-aid recalculation tied to student changes
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Registration, residency, or enrollment changes can trigger updated aid calculations and account information.
Institutions can evaluate credit before matriculation, troubleshoot equivalencies, and reassess them after program changes.

distinctive_features.feature: Configurable business processes and academic rules
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Institutions can adapt workflows and policies across departments without custom-code processes.
Agents target transcript processing, transfer-credit evaluation, and academic-requirements management; availability should be confirmed.

distinctive_features.feature: Shared student, employee, finance, grants, and planning data
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: A common data model supports real-time cross-campus reporting and institutional decisions.

weaknesses.issue: Reviews report confusing navigation, unintuitive menus, duplicated paths, and a steep learning curve.
Reviews describe slow page loads, occasional downtime, and performance concerns around upgrades.
The mobile app supports fewer functions than the web experience, and Student Hubs are browser-only.
Ohio State abandoned its implementation effort after substantial investment, illustrating large-project disruption and delivery risk.
No public price list or implementation fee is available; pricing requires a negotiated institutional quote.
Institutions needing attendance, transport, library, health, discipline, special education, boarding, or alumni tools need other products or integrations.
Workday does not publicly identify one universal Student hosting region; institutions must confirm tenant data residency contractually.

ai_features: AI-powered search and assistance in Student Hubs
Predictive views, including at-risk-student and top-application signals
Student Administration Agent for transcript processing, transfer-credit evaluation, and academic requirements
Some agent capabilities are newly announced; confirm general availability contractually.
pricing_model_summary: No public price list, per-student rate, implementation fee, or free trial; institutional subscription pricing is negotiated and quote-based.
biggest_strategic_gap: The platform is higher-education-focused, not a complete K–12 suite; major projects can be costly and disruptive, and some adjacent needs require integrations.
